_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Import finished — check forHumans for the preview link.

description: Import URL to draft. On complete, response may include requiredDecision — preview then ask mirror vs editable before structure_*.

keyConvention.description: Content key shape: directory = Astro dist (about/index.html); default flat

mode.description: Default auto — per-page mirror with silent render escalation

pages.description: Explicit page list; omit to import sourceUrl as index.html

segments.description: Split-origin segments — each expands into pages by fetching its own `sitemap`. A segment without `sitemap` imports only its pathPrefix hub page (with a warning), not the whole prefix.

sitemap.description: Sitemap path relative to sourceUrl, e.g. /designs/sitemap.xml. Omit only to import this segment's single hub page — expansion does NOT happen without it, and a segment_hub_only warning is returned as a reminder.

workspace.description: Workspace org id or slug (multi-workspace only; omit if one workspace).

name: import_site_from_url
